name: Phase Electronics
old_description: Phase Electronics strives to be a leader in quality. Our policy is continuous improvement through customer satisfaction. 100% of our assemblies are inspected by hand or automated optical inspection (AOI) machines to verify a quality assembly.
about:
Phase Electronics is a privately owned, family-run electronics manufacturer based in Rockville, Maryland. The company was established in 1984 by David Regnier, who remains president and owner, and has operated continuously as a small family business since its inception.

Operating from an owner-occupied 26,000-square-foot facility, Phase Electronics provides a range of electronic manufacturing services including rapid prototyping, medium-volume production, surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, electromechanical box builds, cable assemblies, rework, conformal coating, X-ray inspection, and programming and testing. The plant is fully ESD-safe and equipped with modern machinery, including automated optical inspection systems. The staff consists of long-tenured, IPC-trained employees, many with 15-plus years at the company.

The company serves customers in the commercial, military, medical, and automotive sectors, delivering assemblies built to IPC-A-610 Class 2 standards with Class 3 available on request. All personnel handling assemblies are trained to J-STD-001 with the space addendum.

Phase Electronics emphasizes a direct line to the manufacturing floor for real-time issue resolution, 100 percent inspection via automated optical inspection and hand checks, and compliance with J-STD-001 including the space addendum. The firm is ITAR registered, holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, and is SAM registered, aiming to provide quality manufacturing at reasonable prices within customer time constraints.
